text: /* @component: .custom-swiper-indicator-multy */ (function () { function initIndicatorMultySwiper() { document.querySelectorAll('.custom-swiper-indicator-multy').forEach(function (container) { if (container.dataset.init === 'true') return; container.dataset.init = 'true'; const parentSection = container.closest('.custom-swiper-indicator-multy-section') || container.parentElement || container; const q = String.fromCharCode(34); new Swiper(container, { slidesPerView: 1, spaceBetween: 20, loop: false, observer: true, observeParents: true, navigation: { nextEl: parentSection.querySelector('.swiper-button-multy-next'), prevEl: parentSection.querySelector('.swiper-button-multy-prev') }, pagination: { el: parentSection.querySelector('.swiper-indicator-multy-pagination'), clickable: true, bulletClass: 'custom-bullet', bulletActiveClass: 'is-active', renderBullet: function (index, className) { return 'Tab ' + (index + 1) + ''; } } }); }); } if (!document.getElementById('swiper-css')) { const link = document.createElement('link'); link.id = 'swiper-css'; link.rel = 'stylesheet'; link.href = 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/swiper@11/swiper-bundle.min.css'; document.head.appendChild(link); } if (typeof Swiper !== 'undefined') { initIndicatorMultySwiper(); } else { let script = document.getElementById('swiper-js'); if (!script) { script = document.createElement('script'); script.id = 'swiper-js'; script.src = 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/swiper@11/swiper-bundle.min.js'; document.head.appendChild(script); } script.addEventListener('load', initIndicatorMultySwiper); } })(); /* @end: .custom-swiper-indicator-multy */
